bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

secret_menu.description: {name} needs an 8-byte secret key before it will accept commands, and it couldn't be read directly from the device (that only works while the device is unbound / factory-reset). How do you want to provide it?

menu_options.secret_cloud: Fetch it from my Govee account

secret_cloud.description: Log in with your Govee account to fetch {name}'s secret key automatically. Your credentials are used once to retrieve the key and are not stored — only the key is saved.

secret_manual.description: Enter {name}'s 8-byte secret key as 16 hex characters (e.g. a1b2c3d4e5f60718). When adding the device you can leave it blank to set the key later; a replacement key after a rejection can't be blank. You can obtain it from the Govee cloud account or a btsnoop capture.

reauth_confirm.title: Secret key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: {name} rejected its stored secret key. This happens when the key is wrong or the device was re-paired to a Govee account (which rotates the key). How do you want to provide the new one?

menu_options.secret_cloud: Fetch it from my Govee account

reconfigure.description: Reload {name}. For devices that need a secret key, enter a new key to replace the stored one (leave blank to keep it), or tick the box to remove it.

error.invalid_secret: The secret key must be 16 hex characters (8 bytes), e.g. a1b2c3d4e5f60718.
error.cannot_connect: Could not log in to the Govee account or reach the Govee cloud. Check your email, password and internet connection, then try again.
error.secret_not_found: Logged in, but no secret key was found for this device on the account. Make sure the device is added to this Govee account.

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured supported Govee devices found.
abort.not_supported: This Govee model isn't supported by this integration yet.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error: the setup flow lost track of the device. Please start again.

progress.read_secret: Trying to read {name}'s secret key directly from the device. This only works while it is unbound (factory-reset) and can take up to a minute.

capture_session.name: Capture session
capture_session.description: Run the full device self-test against the targeted Govee device(s) and return the captured BLE session (decoded frames + per-step ACK/read-back results).

secret_rejected.message: {device_name} rejected its secret key. Update it via the re-authentication prompt in Settings > Devices & services.

self_test_busy.message: A self-test is already running; try again when it has finished.

no_matching_device.message: No Govee BLE Local device matched the service target.

sku_unknown.message: Could not determine the Govee model of {address} yet; waiting for its advertisement.

device_not_found.message: Could not find the Govee device {address} over Bluetooth; make sure it is powered on and in range.

model_not_supported.message: The Govee model {sku} is not supported by this version of the integration.

secret_malformed.message: The stored secret key for {device_name} is malformed; enter it again via the re-authentication prompt.
